text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was in the neighboring town with 
Oguri Cap for a TV interview. On the way 
back...
choice_data_list: Oguri's... not here...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She gets lost easily. I tried to keep an 
eye on her, but she seems to have gotten 
swallowed up by the holiday crowd. When I 
hurry to give her a call..."
choice_data_list: オグリが、いない……！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, I was holding onto 
her smartphone before the interview. I 
have to hurry and find her...!
choice_data_list: （着信音が、俺のバッグの中から……！？）
（着信音が、私のバッグの中から……！？）

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer isn't here... What should I 
do...?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, right. When we talked this 
morning, I'm pretty sure—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Even if I get lost, I just need to stay 
calm, right? Eat a meal, and go about 
things as usual...
choice_data_list: Yeah! I'll find the rest, so don't worry!
Yeah! Don't worry, I'll find the rest!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Right. Let's eat and calm down. It 
will be fine... If it's my Trainer."
choice_data_list: ああ！あとは俺が見つけるから、安心して！
うん！あとは私が見つけるから、安心して！

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Alright... Let's head to the shop, then.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I recall—right. It was croquettes, 
omurice, and ramen.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I went to the shopping district looking 
for Oguri Cap. When I asked the lady at 
the deli counter about her...

text_block_list.name: Deli Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you the 'Trainer'? That 
white-haired girl bought a croquette from 
me a bit ago! She said she was heading 
over that way!
choice_data_list: R-Really?! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ponder while staring at the croquettes 
on display. For some reason, she seems to 
be heading somewhere while eating her 
rice...
choice_data_list: ほ、本当ですか！ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, when we went over 
what to do if we got lost before leaving, 
she asked me, 'What should I eat to calm 
down?'..."
choice_data_list: ……待てよ、コロッケって……
……待って、コロッケって……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I said anything on the menu was fine... 
but I think I named a few things like 
croquettes and omurice.
choice_data_list: Don't tell me... all of that!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright, finished the omurice too. Now if 
I just eat some ramen, I should be able to 
see Trainer...!
choice_data_list: まさか……それを全部！？

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, walking around might make me even 
more... Well, if that happens, I can just 
eat something again.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
If it's this child, she was here just a 
moment ago! She walked off in that 
direction!
choice_data_list: (This is... no doubt about it!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is making her way through town, 
tracing the very food menu she mentioned 
earlier! What was the next item on her 
list...?
choice_data_list: （これは……間違いない！）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look at the takeout menu and ponder. But 
there's no way I can remember such a 
fleeting conversation. Which means, from 
here on...
choice_data_list: （オグリが好きなものを言ったはず……！）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aside from ramen shops, diners, 
traditional sweet shops... Every single 
place we visited had reports of Oguri Cap 
sightings!
choice_data_list: ――彼女の好みを、予想して動くしかない！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I just can't catch up to her. Relying on 
the Japanese sweets shop clerk saying, 
"She headed that way just a moment ago," I 
head toward the riverbank, and...
choice_data_list: 勘は冴えてる！けど……

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Nn... Oh, Trainer! I knew you'd find me.
choice_data_list: Oguri...! Are you all right!?
Oguri...! Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's all thanks to you, Trainer! I 
made sure to eat just as you told me so I 
wouldn't get hungry.
choice_data_list: オグリ……！大丈夫だったか！？
オグリ……！大丈夫だった！？

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I meant to tell her to calm down... but it 
seems she interpreted it as "eat your food 
as you're told."
choice_data_list: （やっぱり、そうだったのか……！）
（やっぱり、そうだった……！）

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Trainer, what's in that bag? It 
smells really good.
choice_data_list: （なんであれ……見つかってよかった）

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Fried food from the shopping 
street... omelet rice, and even dumplings 
from the ramen shop! These are all places 
I've been to...!
choice_data_list: ああ、これは……

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
choice_data_list: オグリを捜しながら、買っておいたんだ
オグリを捜しながら、買っておいたの

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... That's amazing, Trainer. Are you a 
psychic?
choice_data_list: ……たくさん歩いたら、お腹空くと思ってな
……たくさん歩いたら、お腹空くと思ってね

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We spread a handkerchief on the grass near 
the riverbank and laid out our meal. It 
was just like an evening picnic.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"So much food, what a wonderful sight. 
...Trainer, thank you so very much."
choice_data_list: If you like it, then I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, that's not what I meant. How 
should I put it... let's see...
choice_data_list: 気に入ってくれたなら、よかった

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
When I got separated... I didn't panic all 
that much.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I figured if Trainer said so, it'd be 
fine. And sure enough, you really found 
it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Retracing the exact same steps as me... 
It's truly incredible. They must know me 
better than I know myself.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're always thinking of me, aren't you? 
That makes me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No matter where I am or what I'm doing. 
Whether it's during a race or not.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"That's what that 'thank you' from earlier 
was for. ...Yeah, I feel like I explained 
that pretty well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her white hair swayed in the evening 
breeze. Though her methods may have been 
off the mark... it seemed my feelings had 
reached her loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's eat before it gets cold. 
Which one do you want, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Eat the restaurant's takeout
Eat a croquette from the shopping street

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Is that... omurice? These soft, runny 
eggs... seem tricky to make.
choice_data_list: お店のテイクアウト品を食べる
商店街のコロッケを食べる

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... During the last cooking class, 
Tama was awfully worried about me too. She 
wouldn't even let me hold a kitchen knife.
choice_data_list: オグリ、料理はあまりしないもんな
オグリ、料理はあまりしないもんね

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What, you understand Tama and the others 
too? You really are psychic...!
choice_data_list: ……なんとなく、気持ちはわかるかも

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Are those... ramen shop gyoza? They're 
nice and crispy. Quite delicious."
choice_data_list: Then do you want Oguri to eat it?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
No, let's split them in half. There are 5 
in total, so... ah.
choice_data_list: それなら、オグリが食べる？

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Are you sure!? ...Thank you, Trainer!
choice_data_list: オグリが3個、俺が2個で！
オグリが3個、私が2個で！

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. There was something I needed to 
tell you.
choice_data_list: Hm? What?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "Nice to meet you."
choice_data_list: ん？なに？

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Give my regards to Trainer!" ...The lady 
from the shopping district asked me to 
pass that along. This is what she meant, 
right?
choice_data_list: え？

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Could it be that something is 
different?
choice_data_list: ぷっ……いやそれは……！
